title: A Prospective Registry Studyto Evaluate the Effect of the DCISionRT Test on Treatment Decisions in Patients With DCIS Following Breast Conserving Therapy

rules.rule_text: Clinical decision made to order DCISionRT Test as part of routine patient care
rules.source_text: A clinical decision has been made to order the DCISionRT™ Test as part of routine patient care

rules.rule_text: Histologically confirmed ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) in a single breast
rules.source_text: Patient must have histologically confirmed ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) in a single breast (presence of lobular carcinoma in situ (LCIS) or other benign breast disease in addition to DCIS is acceptable)
rules.notes: LCIS or other benign breast disease in addition to DCIS is acceptable

rules.source_text: Patient must be consented within 120 days after surgery

rules.rule_text: Eligible for or already received breast conserving surgery
rules.source_text: Patient must be eligible for, or have already received breast conserving surgery

rules.rule_text: Eligible to receive radiation and/or systemic treatment
rules.source_text: Patient must be eligible to receive radiation and/or systemic treatment
Patient must be able to provide informed consent

rules.rule_text: Insufficient tissue to generate DCISionRT test results or missing required inputs
rules.source_text: Patient tissue is insufficient to generate DCISionRT test results or required DCISionRT inputs (age, tumor size, margin status, palpability) are missing
rules.notes: Required inputs include: age, tumor size, margin status, palpability

rules.rule_text: Invasive breast cancer or evidence of invasive breast cancer in ipsilateral or contralateral breast
rules.source_text: Patient has invasive breast cancer or evidence in the ipsilateral or contralateral breast of invasive breast cancer, including microinvasion, lymph node involvement, or Paget's disease of the nipple
rules.notes: Includes microinvasion, lymph node involvement, or Paget's disease of the nipple

rules.source_text: Patient has already been surgically treated with a mastectomy for primary DCIS

rules.rule_text: Prior in situ or invasive breast cancer
rules.source_text: Patient has prior in situ or invasive breast cancer
